paragraphs.text: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ. בְּטֶרֶם כָּל־יְצִיר נִבְרָא: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל. אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל. לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלוֹךְ נוֹרָא: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה. וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית. וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גֹּאֲלִי. וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי. מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי. בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה: וְעִם־רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי. יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל נְטִילַת יָדָיִם:

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר יָצַר אֶת־הָאָדָם בְּחָכְמָה וּבָרָא בוֹ נְקָבִים נְקָבִים חֲלוּלִים חֲלוּלִים. גָּלוּי וְיָדוּעַ לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ שֶׁאִם יִפָּתֵחַ אֶחָד מֵהֶם אוֹ יִסָּתֵם אֶחָד מֵהֶם אִי אֶפְשַׁר לְהִתְקַיֵּם וְלַעֲמוֹד לְפָנֶיךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ רוֹפֵא כָל־בָּשָׂר וּמַפְלִיא לַעֲשׂוֹת:

paragraphs.text: ארון Lord of the world, He who has reigned before any form was created.
At the time when by His will everything came into being, then was His Name proclaimed as King.
And after everything ceases to be then He alone inspiring awe will reign.
He was, He is and He will be in glory.
He is unique and there is no second to compare with Him or to associate with Him.
Without beginning, without end, to Him might and dominion belong.
He is my God and my Redeemer lives .
The rock of my portion in time of distress.
He is my banner and a refuge for me, the portion of my cup on the day I call.
Into His hand I entrust my spirit at the time I sleep and I awake.
And with my spirit my body.
God is with me, I do not fear.
ברוך Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who has sanctified us through His commandments and commanded us to wash the hands.

ברוך Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who with wisdom formed man and created in him many openings, many cavities. It is manifest and known before the throne of Thy glory that if one of them were to remain open or one of them to remain closed, it would be impossible to exist and to appear before Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who heals all flesh and works wonderfully.
In most communities of the German rite אלהי נשמה (P. 5.) follows here.
ברוך Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who has sanctified us through His commandments and commanded us to occupy ourselves with the words of the Torah.

paragraphs.text: וְהַעֲרֶב־נָא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתְךָ בְּפִינוּ וּבְפִי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵינוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּנוּ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ וְלוֹמְדֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ (לִשְׁמָהּ). בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמְלַמֵּד תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בָּנוּ מִכָּל־הָעַמִּים וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה:
יְבָרֶכְךָ יְיָ וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְיָ פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָּ: יִשָּׂא יְיָ פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:

אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שִׁעוּר הַפֵּאָה וְהַבִּכּוּרִים וְהָרְאָיוֹן וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה: אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאָדָם אוֹכֵל פֵּרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהַקֶּרֶן קַיֶּמֶת לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: וְאֵלּוּ הֵן כִּבּוּד אָב וָאֵם וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים וְהַשְׁכָּמַת בֵּית הַמִּדְרָשׁ שַׁחֲרִית וְעַרְבִית וְהַכְנָסַת אוֹרְחִים וּבִקּוּר חוֹלִים וְהַכְנָסַת כַּלָּה וְהַלְוָיַת הַמֵּת וְעִיּוּן תְּפִלָּה וַהֲבָאַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה כְּנֶגֶד כֻּלָּם:

אֱלֹהַי נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה (הִיא) אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ בִּי וְאַתָּה מְשַׁמְּרָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּלָהּ מִמֶּנִּי וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא: כָּל־זְמַן שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמָה בְקִרְבִּי מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי רִבּוֹן כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲדוֹן כָּל־הַנְּשָׁמוֹת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים:

paragraphs.text: והערב And so, O Lord our God, let the words of Thy Torah be pleasing in our mouth and in the mouth of Thy people the House of Israel so that we and our descendants and the descendants of Thy people the House of Israel may all acknowledge Thy Name and learn Thy Torah (with pure intent). Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who teaches the Torah to His people Israel .
ברוך Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who has chosen us from all peoples and given us His Torah. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the giver of the Torah.
יברכך May the Lord bless you and protect you. May the Lord cause His countenance to shine on you and be gracious to you. May the Lord raise His countenance towards you and grant you peace.

אלו The following matters have no legal measure: The corner of the field, the first fruits, the pilgrimage, the practice of charity and study of the Torah. With regard to the following matters man receives an income in this world and the capital is stored for him in the future world: honouring father and mother the practice of charity, early attendance in the House of Study mornings and evenings, hospitality towards strangers, care of the sick, endowment of a bride, escorting the dead, concentration during prayer, peace making between man and his fellow man with the study of Torah outweighing all of them.

אלהי My God, the soul which Thou hast given me is pure. Thou didst create it, Thou didst form it, Thou didst breathe it into me and preserve it within me. Thou wilt eventually take it from me and restore it to me in the future world. As long as the soul is within me I thank Thee, O Lord my God, and God of my fathers, Lord of all works, Master of all souls. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who returns souls to dead bodies.

paragraphs.text: לְפִיכָךְ אֲנַחְנוּ חַיָּבִים לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ וּלְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּלְפָאֶרְךָ וּלְבָרֵךְ וּלְקַדֵּשׁ וְלָתֵת־שֶׁבַח וְהוֹדָיָה לִשְׁמֶךָ: אַשְׁרֵינוּ מַה־טּוֹב חֶלְקֵנוּ וּמַה־נָּעִים גּוֹרָלֵנוּ וּמַה־יָּפָה יְרֻשָּׁתֵנוּ אַשְׁרֵינוּ שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ מַשְׁכִּימִים וּמַעֲרִיבִים עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְאוֹמְרִים פַּעֲמַיִם בְּכָל־יוֹם
שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:

אַתָּה הוּא עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם אַתָּה הוּא מִשֶּׁנִּבְרָא הָעוֹלָם אַתָּה הוּא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה הוּא לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא קַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ עַל מַקְדִּישֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ וְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בְּעוֹלָמֶךָ וּבִישׁוּעָתְךָ תָּרִים וְתַגְבִּיהַּ קַרְנֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בָּרַבִּים:

אַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ וּבִשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם הָעֶלְיוֹנִים. אֱמֶת אַתָּה הוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְאַתָּה הוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ אֵין אֱלֹהִים. קַבֵּץ קֹוֶיךָ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־בָּאֵי עוֹלָם כִּי אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ. אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַיָּם וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּם. וּמִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ בָּעֶלְיוֹנִים אוֹ בַתַּחְתּוֹנִים שֶׁיֹּאמַר לְךָ מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה. אָבִינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֵינוּ וְקַיֶּם־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מַה־שֶּׁכָּתוּב בָּעֵת הַהִיא אָבִיא אֶתְכֶם וּבָעֵת קַבְּצִי אֶתְכֶם כִּי־אֶתֵּן אֶתְכֶם לְשֵׁם וְלִתְהִלָּה בְּכֹל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ בְּשׁוּבִי אֶת־שְׁבוּתֵיכֶם לְעֵינֵיכֶם אָמַר יְיָ:

paragraphs.text: לפיכך Therefore we are obliged to thank Thee, to praise Thee, to glorify Thee, to bless, sanctify and offer praise and thanks to Thy Name. Fortunate are we, how fair is our portion, and how delightful is our destiny and how beautiful is our inheritance. Fortunate are we that early and late, evening and morning, we say twice every day:
Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.
Blessed be His glorious royal Name for ever and ever.

אתה Thou wert before the world was created, Thou art since the world is created, Thou art in this world and Thou art in the future world. Sanctify Thy Name upon those who sanctify Thy Name. Sanctify Thy Name in Thy world and through Thy salvation exalt and elevate our condition. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, sanctifier of Thy Name among the multitude.

אתה Thou art the Lord our God, in heaven and on earth and in the highest heaven. In truth Thou art the first and Thou art the last and besides Thee there is no God. Gather those who hope for Thee from the four corners of the earth, so that all who come into the world may recognize and know that Thou alone art God over all realms of the earth. Thou has made heavens and earth, the sea and everything within them, and who is there among all the work of Thy hands, higher or lower who might say to Thee: What art Thou doing? Our Father in Heaven, show us grace for Thy Great Name's sake, that is called upon us, and fulfil for us, O Lord our God, what is written: at that time I shall bring you, at the time when I gather you. Then will I give you name and fame among all the peoples of the earth, when I lead back your captivities in front of your eyes, says the Lord.
In most communities of the German rite the benedictions of the Torah (page 4) are inserted here.
